title: A reflective infographic exploring the emotional and cognitive fluctuations that can follow ketamine-assisted healing. This piece examines neuroplasticity, Default Mode Network quieting, integration fatigue, and the oscillation between old patterns and emerging ways of being. A reminder that feeling unsettled after profound change is not always regression—it can be part of the process of becoming someone new. #ketamine-therapy #neuroplasticity #nervous-system #healing-journey #mental-health
